breakdown.description: The load is extended from the intended top-right segment to the whole top edge
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to apply the shear traction on the 'full top boundary y = 1'. The ground truth corrects this to apply it only on the 'top-right segment y = 1 with x > 0.5'. The generated specification correctly states, 'A horizontal shear traction of σ_xy=2.65e4 Pa will be applied on the top-right edge segment where y=1 and x > 0.5,' which perfectly matches the ground truth and resolves the inconsistency.
